01

DentoStock

Stock and expiry, handled before they become a problem.

A Flutter inventory app for clinics and small pharmacies. Every item is tracked down to the batch and expiry date, with quiet background alerts before anything runs low or goes out of date.

  • Batch and expiry tracking, not just stock counts
  • One-tap supplier orders by WhatsApp, image, or PDF
  • Barcode scanning for fast entry
  • Works fully offline, backs up to the owner's own Google Drive
FlutterAndroidiOS

DentoQueue

A waiting room that calls patients by name, not guesswork.

A reception dashboard assigns patients to rooms; a second screen in the waiting area calls them forward, out loud and on-screen. No framework, no backend — just a browser and a second display.

  • Room-by-room patient assignment
  • Visual and audio calling display
  • Daily reports on wait times and load
  • Runs entirely in the browser, data stored on-device

DentoClinic

Patients, treatments, and the money, in one place.

Every patient's treatment history, payments, and balance live on one profile. The reports screen turns that into a plain answer: what came in, what went out, what's left.

  • Treatment and payment history per patient
  • Appointment calendar with status tracking
  • Income, expenses, and profit, charted monthly
  • Statements shareable as PDF or straight to WhatsApp

DentoTimer

Two minutes, four quadrants, one very patient mascot.

Sparky talks kids through a full brushing session — a different corner of the mouth every thirty seconds — then celebrates with them when the timer hits zero. Streaks and badges keep them coming back tomorrow.

  • Animated mascot with real voice lines, in Arabic and English
  • Separate profiles for every sibling
  • Streaks, badges, and a monthly calendar of progress
  • Local reminders, no account, no internet required
FlutterAndroidiOS

The same three decisions, every time.

Offline by default

Every product stores its data on the device it runs on. Nothing to host, nothing to leak, nothing that stops working without a connection.

Built to be rebranded

Each project ships with its own step-by-step guide to the name, icon, colors, and package ID — written for whoever picks it up next, not just for us.

One team, four shipped products

Not a template farm. Each app is designed and built around what its specific users actually do all day.
